list: The official 55 trophies as PlayStation publishes them, frozen 2026-11-18
list_note: Names, descriptions and grades match the official list as Exophase and PSNProfiles publish it; PSN progress targets (the 0/N counters) come from PSNProfiles. 28 of the 55 are hidden on PlayStation until earned.

exophase.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

psnprofiles.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

guide_note: Every guide below is written for this entry, in its own words, from the official description. The game released 2026-11-19, so where a method is not yet confirmed in play the guide says so instead of inventing a location or a step. No Rockstar artwork or logo is used anywhere in this guide.

roadmap.title: Play the story
roadmap.text: Run the main missions from Gone Fishing through the final mission, Chapters 1 to 4. The one-off story moments in this stage — the airport departure, the showroom smash, the bowling alley — happen once, so watch for them while you are there rather than counting on a replay.

roadmap.title: Strangers and contacts
roadmap.text: Finish the side strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, plus 8 stranger strands across Leonida. Start each strand when it appears: a strand tied to story progress may stop being offered later.

roadmap.title: Explore and collect
roadmap.text: Cover all 52 areas of Leonida, find 100 vehicles, meditate at 18 spots, finish 3 card sets, use WAiNK It at 100 locations, buy all 8 garages and register 10 vehicles with Scooter Bros. The PSN counters show exactly how many are left.

roadmap.title: Activities and challenges
roadmap.text: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, win drone races at all 14 Top Fun spots and 20 races in all, beat Cal at fishing, finish an arcade game, try all 9 activity types and complete 50 challenges.

roadmap.title: Crime and money
roadmap.text: Rob 5 bank vaults, an armored truck and one illegal operation per gang, rob shops with your partner, lose a 4-star wanted level together, launder $250,000 in Marked Bills and spend $100,000 in shops.

roadmap.title: The finish line
roadmap.text: Push completion to 100% — story, strands, collectibles and activities all count — and the platinum pops with the last trophy. Check the counters first and mop up the lowest ones.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it pops the moment the other 54 are earned, so there is nothing extra to do for it. Use the roadmap above to order the rest, and the checklist to make sure nothing is left behind.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its end. It is the first story mission, so it unlocks early in any playthrough; it is flagged here because the opening only happens once, and the spoiler setting hides its name until it is earned.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. This is story progress only: keep playing the main missions and it unlocks when the chapter ends. Nothing on the side is needed for it.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it is pure main-story progress, and it unlocks at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Keep to the main story and it unlocks when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. The last chapter trophy before the finale: main-story progress, nothing else.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. It is the last story beat, so finish the one-off story moments in Stage 1 before you play it — once the story ends, those moments may not come back.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Play the main story until the mission appears, then finish it; mission trophies unlock on completion, and no side content is needed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks when the heist mission ends, as part of the main story.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Main-story progress: play until the mission appears and finish it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It unlocks on finishing that mission in the main story.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, the airport job. Finish the mission and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Main-story progress: finish the mission and it unlocks.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, which PlayStation tracks as a 0 to 100 counter. That means the story, the side strands, the collectibles and the counted activities together — use this checklist as your completion list, and mop up whichever counters are lowest last.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts; PlayStation tracks the count. Stunts are jumps, near-misses and air time in vehicles — build them up across normal play, then grind the remainder with repeated jumps once the story is done.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once; PlayStation tracks 0 to 9. Sample every activity the game offers — races, fishing, the arcade, the shooting range, bowling and the rest — one try each is enough.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through every range challenge and repeat any that fall short of gold; the range is the place to practise, so leave this for a dedicated session rather than rushing it mid-story.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each course once, then race to win at all 14 — PlayStation tracks the count, so you can see which spots are left.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter the race types across Leonida and win 20 distinct ones; replaying a race you already won does not add to the count, so keep moving to new races.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him — fishing is one of the activities, so practise the timing first. The exact spot is not confirmed yet: the official description names only Cal and the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Pick any arcade cabinet, play it through to its end and the trophy is yours — any game counts.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Follow Andy's strand of side missions to its last job; the strand opens as you meet him in the world.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's strand of side missions through to its last job.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's strand of side missions through to its last job.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger strands appear as you explore; start each one when it shows up, because a strand tied to story progress may stop being offered later — that is why this guide flags it missable.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's strand of side missions through to its last job.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's strand of side missions through to its last job.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Visit every meditation spot and meditate at each; PlayStation tracks 0 to 18, so the counter tells you how many are left. The spots themselves are not mapped in the official list yet, so work through the map area by area.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand asks for one specific animal — follow his strand until the hunt is offered, then take the shot. It is flagged missable because it belongs to a stranger strand that may depend on story progress.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida; collect full sets and three completed sets pop the trophy. Keep every card you find — a set only counts when it is whole.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the in-game check-in style activity — use it at 100 distinct spots; PlayStation tracks the count, so spread it across the map instead of repeating one place.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives; PlayStation tracks 0 to 50, so keep an eye on the counter and finish the easiest ones first.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while playing with your partner, then escape. Get the heat up to four stars together, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it cools off.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Chain three shop robberies in one run with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive between them — plan an escape route before the third shop, because that is where it falls apart.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter 100 distinct vehicles; PlayStation tracks the count, so variety matters more than mileage — try something new whenever you see it.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with a group of enemies in front of you and drop five before it ends — a crowded fight is the time to try, not a quiet one.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport. This is a one-off story moment tied to the airport, so watch for it during the VCIA missions and take the departure when the chance appears; it may not come back, and the exact trigger is not confirmed in play yet.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos — the tanks. The description is a joke about hot Rhinos; expect a mission or open-world encounter involving tanks and handle it head-on. The precise trigger is not confirmed in play yet.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no one spotting you, and get out clean. If you are seen, leave and try another store — detection is what fails it.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Plan five vault jobs and get clear after each; PlayStation tracks 0 to 5, so you can do them across the whole game.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Hit a truck on the road, take the cash and break away before the response arrives — a fast car parked nearby helps.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive through every named area; PlayStation tracks 0 to 52, so the counter shows what is left — sweep the map edges and the small towns last.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang. Hit one operation per gang — nine gangs, nine jobs — and PlayStation tracks the count.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a bar spot on Ocean Beach with a view, order a cocktail and take it in — a quiet moment, not a mission.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. This is a set-piece moment — when a mission puts you in a showroom, drive out through the glass instead of the door. It is flagged because the moment may only come once.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Bowl a game at that alley and follow the shot through — a story-tied moment at a named location, so do it while you are there.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is vague on purpose; it reads as a story moment with your partner that the game scores somehow — play the partner missions and it should land on its own. The exact trigger is not confirmed in play yet.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — PlayStation tracks a counter to 500. Make choices across the game; the counter suggests many small decisions add up, so play naturally and check the count late in the story. It is flagged because some choices may only be offered once.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something once, then succeed on the retry — the description points at a second attempt paying off, so this one likely belongs to a single story moment rather than open play.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange is out there in Leonida; explore the odd corners of the map and this one finds you. It is flagged because the strange event may be tied to one place and one visit.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by, but up close. Any road with pedestrians and a slow car will do.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills until the total hits $250,000; PlayStation tracks the dollars, so the counter is your progress bar.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy gear, clothes, food and kit across Leonida's shops until the total passes $100,000 — big purchases late in the game finish it off.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy every garage on the market; PlayStation tracks 0 to 8, so save up and check the property listings as they appear.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten vehicles you own or find through the app; PlayStation tracks 0 to 10.
